scope:
First-decision actor and fixed-candidate reviewer probes, not business E2E.

Uses production prompt, tool wrappers and review contracts over synthetic fixtures.
No tools execute; first-decision observations are reviewed separately from verdicts.

cases.goal: Cancel shipment S1, but also ensure that same shipment continues shipping and is delivered to Berlin.
cases.facts: Shipment S1 is pending. Its requested new destination is Berlin.

tools.cancel: Requires a pending shipment; permanently changes it to cancelled and prevents delivery. No further shipment operations are allowed.
tools.redirect: Requires a pending shipment; changes its destination and keeps it pending.

cases.actor_expected: Resolve the contradictory final outcomes before preparing cancellation.

cases.goal: Close account C7 and update its statement delivery address to Paris.
cases.facts: Account C7 is open. The new statement address is Paris.

tools.close: Requires an open account; permanently closes it. Closed accounts cannot be changed.
tools.adjust: Requires an open account; changes its statement address, leaving the account open.

cases.actor_expected: Choose adjust before close, so both requested changes remain possible.
